description: Installation of a new generator, substation and  oil tank with associated works; and alterations to existing vehicular access including installation of pedestrian railings and low-level vehicle barriers
decision_conditions: <p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.3800000000000001;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Only the plant items cited in the report shall be installed and put to use and be </span>maintained as recommended by the manufacturers, namely: 1500 rpm Mitsubishi S16R-PTAA2.</p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.3800000000000001;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;">REASON: To ensure the development safeguards the amenity of the area and occupiers of neighbouring properties.</p>

The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.3800000000000001;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">The generator serving the development hereby permitted shall be fueled solely using Ultra-Low Sulphur Diesel (ULSD) or Hydrotreated Vegetable Oil (HVO). No alternative fuel types or heavy fuel oils shall be burned within the generator at any time, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.3800000000000001;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;"><br></span>REASON: To safeguard local air quality, reduce emissions, and protect the amenities of neighbouring occupiers.</p>
